description: This file defines a React component `ViewDetailsModal` that renders a modal dialog to display detailed information about a JSON object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels and currency values, and handles special display cases for certain keys such as user cost. The component is designed to be generic and reusable across the application.

methods.name: React.useMemo
methods.description: Memoizes the entries to avoid recalculating unless data changes.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key resembles a user cost key using regex matching.

methods.name: toNumberLike
methods.description: Converts a value to a number representing USD, using utility function.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a data value as a string or JSX element, with special formatting for user cost keys.
